package main

import (
	"device/arm"
	"machine"
	"time"
)

var ticks uint32

func onPin(p machine.Pin) { ticks++ }

func main() {
	btn := machine.GPIO15
	btn.Configure(machine.PinConfig{Mode: machine.PinInputPullup})
	_ = btn.SetInterrupt(machine.PinFalling, onPin)
	for {
		arm.Asm("nop")
		time.Sleep(time.Second)
	}
}
